reason: Opt-in macOS Mach service registration for sandboxed Chromium (see https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/issues/210), and signals to any of the user's processes, since each command gets a new sandbox and could not stop servers from earlier commands. Source hashes pin this patch to the reviewed npm release.
